Northwind Supply — Pricing

Our standard plan is $49 per seat per month, billed annually. The growth plan is $89 per seat and adds unlimited exports, priority support and a dedicated onboarding session.

Enterprise pricing is available on request; contact sales@northwind-supply.example for a quote.
